podcast.body: This single was released in October 1977 and also achieved a top 10 position on the charts. "The single after that was Holidays in the Sun. That was in October."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was recorded at Wessex Studios with a lineup reduced to Johnny Rotten, Steve Jones (who also played bass after Glenn Matlock was fired), and Paul Cook. Producer Chris Thomas implemented his "mono deluxe" technique, involving layered, pitch-shifted guitar parts and a duplicated bass line one octave lower, to create the band's signature studio sound. "The sex bestows with holiday in the sun recorded at Westc studios in the old church hall behind St. Augustine's church in North London."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
